# retry-backoff (loop-retry)

> Generic async retry with exponential backoff and jitter: `RetryConfig`
> presets (`default`, `no_retries`, `aggressive`) and custom budgets,
> `delay_for_attempt` overflow-safe policy math, `with_backoff` as the retry
> executor, `RetryError` for exhaustion outcomes, and the caller-owned
> `IsRetryable` trait for retryability classification (REQ-RB-001..200).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): retry semantics, configuration, error classification, usage.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-RB-001..200 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model referenced by requirement threat IDs.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
